Name: Single_FK
Description: This will create a Single FK Ctrl + Joint, Like for COG or Single Needs

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create a Single FK Ctrl + Joint, Like for COG or Single Needs.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- CtrlType: choose one option (for example: sphere, cube, square, octagon).
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- CtrlColor: choose one option (for example: lightBlue, blue, white, purple).
- Gimbal: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- CreateJoint: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- SetCtrlParent_Hierarchy: set the node/object name this block should use.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
